correctness.rationale: Gaussian Wick identities give E L^4=3a^4, E L²Q²=2a²h+8v^T A²v, E Q^4=12h²+48tr A^4. Matrix inequalities v^T A²v≤a²h and tr A^4≤h² are simultaneously sharp for aligned rank one; normalize w=a²/(a²+2h) and optimize U_r(w)=3r²w²+30r³w(1-w)+15r⁴(1-w)². Derivatives give transition at r=1/5 and rational mixed maximum, with equality cases. Independently derived 1D fourth moment 3a⁴+60a²b²+60b⁴ and checked symbolic identity M-U=3r²(10r-1-5r²)(w-w*)² and threshold root r*=0.45164410203579086. Semigroup monotonicity yields exact contractivity threshold.
